name: Logitech Unifying Receiver (mouse)
notes: 148-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface (interface 1) of a real Logitech Unifying Receiver, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://github.com/libusb/hidapi/issues/531#issuecomment-1509578704. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
